snippet.title: wishbound. — Official Launch Trailer | PS5
snippet.description:
it's 3am. a new app installed itself. it's called tally.

wishbound is a psychological horror game that takes place entirely inside a
phone. tally grants wishes — all of them. every wish triggers a playable dream,
and losing a dream means the monkey's paw writes the story instead.

every wish is granted. every wish is owed.

• 5 nights, 3 routes, 18 endings
• a full run is ~2 hours — built for one-sitting playthroughs
• platinum trophy
• $9.99

Out July 20, 2026 on PlayStation 5.

https://store.playstation.com/en-us/product/HB2639-PPSA39083_00-0202981640883665
